product_metadata.title: DSMY Suction Cup Hooks, Removable Home Kitchen Bathroom Small Suction Cups Wall Hooks for Glass Towel Hangers, Utility Hooks, Hanging Supplies - 27 Packs (27-PCS)
features: 【Size】: 3 various sizes in diameter: Large 2.5"(7pcs), Medium 1.7"(10 pcs), Small 1.2"(10 pcs),3 size mixed, for different smooth surface

【Super Suction】: Thicken clear PVC suction cup, hold up to 8lbs, provide a tight hold on smooth non-porous surfaces, including appliances, windows, mirrors, glass, metal, ceramic tile, plastic, Formica, etc
【Rustproof】: High-quality and environmentally friendly materials ensure safety, unique transparent design makes it almost imperceptible. No rusting and no loss of adhesion when exposed to water

【Removable】: Hooks and suction cups are detachable and can be used separately, has a release tab for easy removal, no tools needed, install and tear off in only a few seconds, without any damage to the surface

【Application】: Perfect utility for bathroom, kitchen, indoor and outdoor can hang cups, hats, keys, bath towels, towels, plants, small bathroom items, outdoor wreaths, decorations in windows, all sorts of small toys, key chain, etc
